snippet.title: An Ecospace of Epochs: Demo Gameplay
snippet.description:
Download: https://amaxivermis.itch.io/an-ecospace-of-epochs

Game Description:
You're a paleontologist in a far future from a different planet in an interconnected universe, you've got a new home that's yours in the sparsely populated part of the planet and you help with studying the past life and world spanning nearly a billion years ago.

Currently you can research body fossils, and to a limited degree do it with trace fossils to find their diet. Time travel is available but very limited right now.
